title: Experimental Design & Baselines
description: Study choose strong fair baselines, control variables and confounders, ablations and component interactions, and predefine metrics and stopping. Each lesson includes a worked example and an applied practice task.

lessons.title: Choose strong fair baselines
lessons.description: Allocate a comparable tuning budget and document configurations.
lessons.conceptOverview: Baselines should be relevant, competently configured and evaluated under comparable conditions. An artificially weak baseline exaggerates the apparent contribution.
lessons.whyItMatters: Baseline quality affects the credibility of reported gains.

lessons.title: Control variables and confounders
lessons.description: Design a staged experiment that isolates at least one factor.
lessons.conceptOverview: Change the intended factor while holding other influential conditions stable or explicitly modeling them. When multiple factors change, attribute results cautiously.
lessons.whyItMatters: Confounded changes do not identify a single cause.

lessons.title: Ablations and component interactions
lessons.description: Explain why redundant or interacting components can produce this pattern.
lessons.conceptOverview: An ablation removes or changes a component to estimate its contribution under the tested system. Interactions mean component effects may not add independently.
lessons.whyItMatters: Ablation effects depend on the surrounding configuration.

lessons.title: Predefine metrics and stopping
lessons.description: Define a fixed evaluation budget and a primary endpoint.
lessons.conceptOverview: Choose primary metrics and stopping rules before inspecting results when possible. Repeatedly checking and selecting favorable outcomes can bias conclusions.
lessons.whyItMatters: Stopping rules influence the interpretation of results.
